name: cooling_tower_counterflow_outlet
title: Counterflow cooling tower, outlet water temperature
summary: Teaching exercise: outlet water temperature of a counterflow cooling tower rated as a dry exchanger between the water and a fictitious fluid on the moist-air wet-bulb temperatures, with the outlet air saturated.

origin.course: ULiège MSTh (J. Lebrun, V. Lemort, S. Bertagnolio), session of 2005-10-24, exercise 1

verification.summary: Compared with the solution stored in MSTH051024exercice1.EES (EES 7.458): 24 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001). Outlet water is 25.555 °C and the heat rate is 1.977 MW (EES 25.555 °C and 1.977 MW). Largest relative difference 6.52e-4 on c_p_f, from the humid-air specific heat (CoolProp vs EES).
verification.reference: Solution stored in MSTH051024exercice1.EES (EES 7.458, candidate TM-0093)
verification.notes: 24 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0.
